Social Media router — OAuth connection management and cross-platform posting.

| Method | Path | Summary |

| GET | [`/api/social/accounts`](#get-api-social-accounts) | List all connected social media accounts. |

| GET | [`/api/social/projects`](#get-api-social-projects) | All content projects, with the linked YouTube channel name if any. |

<a id="get-api-social-accounts"></a>
### `GET /api/social/accounts`

List all connected social media accounts.

- Handler: [`list_accounts`](../../../backend/routers/social.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

- `200`: JSON list of rows of `social_accounts`: `id`, `platform`, `account_id`, `account_name`, `account_type`, `token_expires_at`, `meta_json`, `created_at`

<a id="get-api-social-config"></a>
### `GET /api/social/config`

Which platforms have OAuth credentials, and where they're read from.

The UI uses this to tell the user exactly which variables are missing and which file to put them in (that path differs between a source checkout and a packaged build — see backend/api.py). Reports presence only: never a client id or secret.

- Handler: [`social_config`](../../../backend/routers/social.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `env_file`, `redirect_base`, `configured` (JSON object with no fields), `env_vars` (JSON object with no fields)
